design_rationales.design: Gaussian soft splat with inverse-depth weighting
design_rationales.concrete_problem: Hard projection yields sparse support, quantization misalignment, and hard occlusion handling.
design_rationales.causal_mechanism: A finite Gaussian neighborhood expands pixel coverage while inverse depth favors foreground contributions.
design_rationales.alternatives_tradeoffs: Bilinear/differentiable rasterizers or learned kernels may preserve coordinate gradients; larger windows cost more and can oversmooth.

design_rationales.design: Hybrid EdgeConv and Transformer geometric tokenizer
design_rationales.concrete_problem: A single operator struggles to preserve both local curvature and global topology.
design_rationales.causal_mechanism: EdgeConv extracts neighborhoods while self-attention propagates long-range token context.
design_rationales.alternatives_tradeoffs: Pure convolution is cheaper; pure attention has weaker local inductive bias; bundled components hinder attribution.

design_rationales.concrete_problem: Passive concatenation does not force geometry-conditioned use of visual cues.
design_rationales.causal_mechanism: Geometry tokens query visual keys and values to select view context.
design_rationales.alternatives_tradeoffs: Concatenation or gating is cheaper; current three-token visual compression may lose spatial detail.

design_rationales.concrete_problem: Visual prior strength must be balanced against overcapacity on PCN.
design_rationales.causal_mechanism: Compact pretraining supplies transferable view features without the reported degradation of 21M.
design_rationales.alternatives_tradeoffs: ResNet or larger TinyViT variants change capacity and latency; the overfitting mechanism lacks train/validation evidence.

design_rationales.concrete_problem: One-shot decoding has difficulty balancing coarse skeleton recovery and fine detail.
design_rationales.causal_mechanism: The decoder merges input/coarse points and refines them through structure self-attention and local cross-attention at two scales.
design_rationales.alternatives_tradeoffs: One-stage, folding, or diffusion decoders may trade quality for memory and latency.

design_rationales.concrete_problem: Standard geometry metrics cannot establish whether a multimodal model uses visual input.
design_rationales.causal_mechanism: Visual removal measures output semantic sensitivity while entropy-times-coverage summarizes representation yield.
design_rationales.alternatives_tradeoffs: Multiple intervention strengths, geometry metrics, alternative oracles, and causal mediation would reduce oracle/OOD confounds.

limitations.requirement: Independent empirical gradient reproduction beyond paper/code cross-check
limitations.reason: Current code uses fixed finite offsets and integer scatter indices; no gradient-norm experiment establishes the claimed continuous x/y geometry gradient.
limitations.effect_on_conclusions: The PCN replacement gain remains supported, but the stronger continuous-gradient/PMI mechanism claim is unverified.
